saw_lines: Natural deodorant buyers test one scent, then refill the same case for years, and they stay loyal to it.
So the sale is won at the first order, when a new buyer decides whether to subscribe at all.
Your site shows 72,000 5-star reviews, yet 0 of 29 live ads use that number. Put it on the creative and in the first line of your next batch.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 72,000 5-star reviews, yet 0 of 29 live ads carry that number, so new buyers see no proof. Put 72,000 on the creative and in the first line, then open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers 20% off when you subscribe, yet 0 of 18 copy ads mention it, so a first buyer has no reason to subscribe. Put subscribe and save in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your 18 copy ads open 13 different ways, and the biggest story leads only 3. Thin spread means no line gets enough ads to read clearly. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them, three ads each.

20 ads have run 60+ days, so you have proven ground. Your oldest, the try before you buy ad, is the one to copy. Build three variations with the same two steps and new shots, so no single ad carries the account.

ads_1: Deodorant creative opening on the subscribe offer and two review quotes
